planting.note: Plant container stock in spring into sandy, acidic, well-drained soil in full sun once frost danger has passed.

directions: Plant in sandy, acidic soil of pH 5 to 6.5 in full sun, where this Eastern Cape heath produces masses of small bell-shaped pink to lilac flowers in late winter and early spring. It is one of the more commercially available true Cape ericas in the specialty nursery and cut-flower trade, distinct from the hardier Northern Hemisphere Erica carnea and Erica vagans cultivars already in wider cultivation. Give it excellent drainage and withhold heavy summer irrigation, since it is adapted to a winter-rainfall climate and is prone to root rot in soggy soil.

planting.note: Plant container stock in spring into lean, acidic, well-drained soil in full sun.

directions: Plant in lean, acidic, fast-draining soil in full sun, where this Western Cape fynbos heath bears narrow tubular red to pink flowers over a long bloom season, attracting sunbirds in its native range. It is a genuinely distinct Cape species from the hardy European heaths and heathers common in American garden centers, and is more often obtained as seed through South African indigenous-seed specialists than as container stock. Keep soil on the dry side between waterings and avoid phosphorus-rich fertilizer, since like most true ericas it is sensitive to high soil phosphate levels.

planting.note: Plant container stock in spring into well-drained soil in full sun; established clumps tolerate brief light frost.

directions: Plant in well-drained, slightly acidic soil in full sun, where this Western Cape restio forms a fine-textured, weeping clump of wiry green stems valued for contrast against broad-leaved fynbos shrubs. Unlike the stiffly upright Thamnochortus insignis or jointed, bamboo-like Elegia capensis already grown in the restio trade, Rhodocoma capensis has a distinctly soft, arching, grass-like texture that sets it apart as a separate ornamental form. It is drought-tolerant once established and benefits from an occasional deep watering during active growth, but otherwise asks for little beyond sharp drainage and sun.
